en.headline: Zhongji Innolight shares fall on debut after HK$53.4 billion Hong Kong listing
en.dek: The Chinese optical-parts maker raised HK$53.41 billion in what became Hong Kong’s largest share sale this year; shares opened below the offer price of HK$980.
body: Shares of Zhongji Innolight (stock code 3308) began trading on the Hong Kong stock exchange on 30 July after the company raised HK$53.41 billion (about US$6.81 billion) in its Hong Kong listing, the city’s largest equity offering so far this year and Asia’s second-largest of 2026.

The Shenzhen-listed optical transceiver manufacturer sold 54.5 million Hong Kong shares at a final offer price of HK$980 each, below the maximum of HK$1,010 set when the deal was launched. The company supplies high-speed optical components used in data centres, cloud networks and artificial-intelligence systems.

On debut the shares opened lower and were reported to have fallen about 0.9 per cent in early trading. The listing is Hong Kong’s biggest since Alibaba’s 2019 offering. Proceeds are expected to support research and development, manufacturing expansion and possible acquisitions.

zh.headline: 中際旭創港股上市集資534億元 首日股價低開
zh.dek: 中國光學零件製造商完成今年本港最大型新股上市，發行價980港元，股份今早低於發行價開出。
body: 中際旭創（股份代號3308）今日在港交所掛牌，集資534.1億港元（約68.1億美元），成為本港今年最大型新股上市，亦是亞洲今年第二大。
這家深圳上市的光模組製造商以每股980港元發行5,450萬股港股，低於招股時所定最高價1,010港元。公司主要生產用於數據中心、雲端網絡及人工智能系統的高速光學元件。
股份首日開市報低於發行價，早段曾下跌約0.9%。是次上市為本港自2019年阿里巴巴以來最大型集資。所得資金預計用於研發、擴產及可能的收購。
